newsitem.title: USA: W.House's Raines sees some progress on budget.
newsitem.headline: W.House's Raines sees some progress on budget.

text.p: White House budget director Frank Raines said some progress had been made in talks with Republican and Democratic budget leaders and all sides agreed to contine the discussions Wednesday.

Speaking to reporters, Raines said the White House had offered additional domestic savings to build on a fund of $57 billion included in President Clinton's budget. "We added a little bit more money to the pot we are building," he said.
"We made some progress. We are not there yet," Raines added.

He added that "for simplicity of discussion" of proposals the White House had used the more conservative estimates of savings developed by the Congressional Budget Office. However, White House economic adviser Gene Sperling said the administration had not agreed to use CBO's more conservative forecasts for economic growth.
